name: A for Athens
description: The hotel is located at the heart of the historical part of Athens city and the picturesque neighborhood of Plaka. It is right next to Monastiraki Square and the metro station that will ease your transportation to and from the airport and Piraeus port . Alimos beach is around 4 km away and Piraeus beach is roughly 7 km away. This establishment offers a total of 33 rooms, all elegantly furnished in a cozy atmosphere. The hotel is air-conditioned and features an all-day bar and restaurant with magnificent views of the Acropolis and Monastiraki Square. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception and currency exchange. Further amenities include a safe, laundry and room services. The accommodation units have a unique style with a family atmosphere. All rooms are fully-equipped as standard and feature wooden floors, as well as high-quality and modern furnishings.
